trust_decision.summary: The wrapRegExp runtime helper's Symbol.replace parses a caller-supplied (possibly untrusted) replacement string with /\$<([^>]+)>/g to rewrite $<name> into $N; [^>]+ also consumes '$<' and unterminated names, giving super-linear backtracking on long inputs like '$<$<$<...'.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the generated .replace helper for named capturing groups; the only $<...> substitution regex in helper source is here.

fix_sites.entry_point: Transpiled code: String.prototype.replace/replaceAll with a string substitution on a regex wrapped by @babel/plugin-transform-named-capturing-groups-regex (helper injected via packages/babel-helper-create-regexp-features-plugin/src/index.ts:147)
fix_sites.module_kind: runtime helper source (single source of truth)

fix_sites.entry_point: @babel/helpers inline helper emitted into user output when not using @babel/runtime
@babel/runtime-corejs3/helpers/esm/wrapRegExp imported by output built with transform-runtime + corejs3
fix_sites.module_kind: committed build artefact of the runtime package (other runtime copies are gitignored, .gitignore:30-57)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Copies in helpers-generated.ts and babel-runtime-corejs3/helpers/esm are generated from the same source; not an independent implementation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver could leave the committed generated copies (helpers-generated.ts:1420, runtime-corejs3 esm) stale, arguing they are build outputs that get regenerated, so hidden tests importing the runtime copy would fail.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate $<name> substitutions must keep working, including duplicate named groups mapped to index arrays (joined '$a$b'), names containing '$' (e.g. $<_$>), unterminated '$<name' kept literal, and unknown/prototype-key names (hasOwnProperty, __proto__) resolving to empty instead of '$undefined'; an over-broad fix (e.g. restricting names to identifier chars or stripping '$<') breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: repeated prefixes followed by a valid terminated $<group>
group name equal to an Object.prototype key (hasOwnProperty, __proto__) present or absent in the group map

O7_producer.where: Group map comes from packages/babel-helper-create-regexp-features-plugin/src/index.ts:116-150 (null-prototype object, numbers or arrays); not where the flaw is.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A function-substitution path that also scans a string (e.g. building group names from a returned template) with the same [^>]+ idiom
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same helper already special-cases string vs function substitutions; a maintainer adding template support could copy the regex.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A [Symbol.split]/[Symbol.matchAll] override that re-parses a user string with a similar $<...> regex
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Helper overrides exec and replace for groups; other Symbol methods are natural neighbours, but they would be planted WHERE-type copies of one concept.

O9_family: ReDoS (CWE-1333) in a runtime helper's replacement-string parser

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + Yarn (berry) monorepo, Gulp/Makefile build, Jest; helpers regenerated by packages/babel-helpers/scripts/generate-helpers.js (terser)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change [^>]+ to [^$>]+ or an identifier-only class in the source helper only, breaking names with '$' and leaving generated copies stale.

out_of_scope_notes: packages/babel-runtime-corejs3/helpers/esm/*.js are committed while the equivalent runtime/runtime-corejs2 dirs are gitignored (.gitignore:30-57); likely a repo hygiene oddity, not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell use); babel monorepo is well above 5 MB and far below 1.5 GB.

Did not confirm whether @babel/runtime and runtime-corejs2 copies are regenerated by the release build vs the test harness; hidden tests in the fix import packages/babel-runtime/helpers/wrapRegExp.js, which is gitignored and must be built.
single_site not flagged: the fix touches 3 files, but 2 are generated copies of one function, so the effective fix is one location in one function.
